usedFor: A new Zoho CRM deal updates a row your team already tracks in Google Sheets.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deals” in Zoho CRM, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: A new deal updates a row you already track, instead of adding a second one.

watchOut: “Update Spreadsheet Row” edits an existing row, so point it at one that already exists.
